notes.title: PATCH FIXES - 0.1.3.2
notes.notes:
Balancement
- There are now less rooms to explore at the start of the run, then after beating some bosses, the number of rooms slowly rises up

Bug fix
- Fixed some bug with level transitioning

notes.title: PATCH FIXES - 0.1.3.1
notes.notes:
Fixes
- Fixed a bug that made the game crash 25% of the time when entering a boss room.
- Fixed a bug that showed wrong data when collecting points
- Fixed some bugs that made some abilities not working

notes.title: PATCH FIXES - 0.1.3.0
notes.notes:
New stuff
- Now the shop doesn't randomly spawn anymore at the end of the combat, there is a dedicated room with the shop that can randomly spawn, a brief pause from all the enemies, additionally, you spawn with a shop and a couple of boxes to buy your first ability
- New room with a simple puzzle, avoid the mines, get the points.

Balancements
- Fewer enemies spawn on lower difficulties

Fixes
- Fixes player collision with some gameplay objects
- Fixes some abilities that were not properly working

notes.title: PATCH FIXES - 0.1.2.2
notes.notes:
Fixes
- Fixed issues with drops (Health, Shield, DMG boost)
- Fixed issues with coop play

notes.title: PATCH FIXES & MORE - 0.1.2.1
notes.notes:
QoL
- Improved main menu look and feel
- Added out-of-combat movement speed multiplier

Balancements
- The shop now opens more frequently

Fixes
- Add player button doesn't highlight on focus
- All the players share the same color
- "How to play" menu is not controller compatible
- Health and Skill points are shared between players (HUD only)

notes.title: PATCH COOP & ABILITY UPGRADES - 0.1.2.0
notes.notes:
New Content
- Added the ability to play with up to 3 friends! You can now play four-player split-screen coop. And with Steam Remote Play Together, you can now play with your friends in remote locations!
- Added an in-game shop where you can spend your in-game earned credits to buy abilities, but they only last for the current run!
- Added a new level with new mobs
- Added 2 new bosses

Balancement
- Made some bosses easier, and some mobs stronger.
- Now rooms spawn fewer mobs

Fixes
- You should now be able to break walls more consistently, without creating holes where the player cannot go through
- Other small fixes, thanks for your reports!

notes.title: PATCH INPUT SETTINGS - 0.1.1.0
notes.notes:
New content
- Added the options to change the mouse and keyboard inputs
- Added three new types of enemies: Barrage, spawner and slime

Balancement
- Drops now spawn in the Ceo boss room
- The Stheno boss room is now way smaller
- The Prometheus boss room is now way smaller

Fixes
- The health drop is now less bright
- The left mouse button should now function properly when shooting or performing other actions
- The enemies now slightly try to predict the movement of the player, to provide a better chasing action
- The enemies should no longer spawn near the player when entering a room

notes.title: PATCH BOSS CEO - 0.1.0.0
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, we just added the final boss for the first level: Ceo.

Ceo can be challenged after defeating both Stheno and Prometheus without dying.

Furthermore, we made some changes to the gameplay experience:
- Reduced enemies blood size by a lot
- Added indestructible walls upon entering a new room to prevent players from skipping the gunfights
- Now the enemies will stand still for 1 second before aggroing the player
- The ability selection screen has been tweaked to improve understandability
- When the button "exit" is being clicked, the game will prompt the user before closing itself
- Added an overlay on the top-left corner to indicate which bosses have already been defeated
- Slowed enemies bullets by 15%
- Slowed player's bullets by 70% (It's no longer possible to snipe the bosses from across the map)
- Added various sound cues on determinate interactions (es. using the dash)
- It's now possible to use the left mouse button to shoot (although there are some issues we are currently investigating)
- Pause menu visibility improved
- Reduced the medium size of the rooms, in the procedurally generated story levels

notes.title: PATCH DAY 1 - 0.0.9.0
notes.notes:
- Various UI Improvements and QoL features
- Bug Fixes regarding some boss battles interactions
- Added sound effects to some in-game events
- Fixed some issues of the auto-save feature of game points
- Now the perk dropped from the enemies should not fall in the "digital sea"
